label: One exploratory unquantized-reference competence check, not final reference selection

generation.reasoning: no separate reasoning mode in this checkpoint
generation.stop_policy: EOS IDs from pinned source generation_config.json; no extra stop strings
generation.template_policy: pinned source tokenizer, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=False then encode(add_special_tokens=False); template supplies its default system message

selection_rationale: Same Qwen2.5 non-thinking qwen2 family and MLX backend; 7.62B BF16 parameters ~15.23GB, feasible within 64GiB; larger models and additional checkpoints outside this check

criteria.applies: each of mathematical and natural variants separately, full coverage required; exploratory competence screen, not preservation
